newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan mayor cuts salary for peeping into women's bath.
newsitem.headline: Japan mayor cuts salary for peeping into women's bath.

text.p: A Japanse mayor said on Friday he would cut his salary by half for six months for peeping into a women's bath.
Yoichiro Iino, the mayor of Kitakata 240 km (140 miles) north of Tokyo, said he would reprimand himself and take the salary cut for looking into a women's bath through a glass door last month.

During an official inspection on April 18 of the newly opened spa run by his city, the 72-year-old mayor walked into the women's dressing room and peeped into the adjacent bath where some 20 naked women were bathing.
"I was worried about how turnout would be after the (April 15-17) free entry promotion ended," the mayor said.
